1. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein said polyalkylenimine is present in an amount that exceeds the amount of said polyanion__.

2. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker, __wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is present in an amount sufficient to provide controlled release of said crosslinker__.

3. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine __having a molecular weight of less than 2000 Da__.

4. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants, __wherein said polyanion has anionic sites available for crosslinking__.

5. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate, __wherein said crosslinker provides delayed release functionality__.

6. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions, __wherein said cations are present in an amount that does not interfere with nanoparticle formation__.

8. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprised a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter, __wherein said nanoparticle maintains structural integrity in reservoir conditions__.

9. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater __for extended periods under reservoir conditions__.

10. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine __of less than 2000 Da__ and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

12. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation __in a controlled release configuration__.

13. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al __in a form suitable for controlled release__.

21. (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer that can be crosslinked with a) __wherein said polymer has anionic sites available for crosslinking with said multivalent cation crosslinker__; and c) a fluid.

22. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is an acrylate-based polymer __having carboxylate groups available for crosslinking__.

23. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide __having a degree of hydrolysis suitable for crosslinking__.

24. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethyacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, __wherein said polymer provides viscosity enhancement upon crosslinking__.

26. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is brine or seawater __having ionic strength suitable for nanoparticle stability__.
